answer: Admission into the economy runs through a quarantined escrow on the mesa: a new identity deposits 6,000 POA and spends 48 hours on a quarantine terrace where every transfer it makes stays reversible by a two-of-three peer committee. The trigger fires when an identity's counterpart graph overlaps an already-escrowed node past a jade-line threshold of shared addresses. Overlap freezes the deposit, and on committee confirmation the whole escrow burns — 6,000 POA per fake identity, scaling linearly with cluster size — while honest identities graduate with the deposit intact and full attest rights.
